title: More Than a Score: Reinforcement Learning with Verbalized Feedback for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for generative recommendation, where recommended items are generated directly from users' interaction histories. To further improve recommendation quality, reinforcement learning (RL) has been applied to align these models with recommendation objectives. However, existing RL methods rely on scalar rewards to implicitly guide exploration. These rewards do not specify which aspects of a candidate conflict with the user's preferences or how the next candidate should differ. To address this gap, we propose VerRec, a verbalized feedback-guided RL framework for generative recommendation. Specifically, a user simulator generates personalized verbalized feedback based on the user's historical preferences and the candidate item profile. translated_title: 不仅仅是分数：基于语言化反馈的生成式推荐强化学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于生成式推荐，即直接根据用户的交互历史生成推荐的物品。为了进一步提升推荐质量，强化学习（RL）已被应用于将这些模型与推荐目标进行对齐。然而，现有的强化学习方法依赖于标量奖励来隐式地引导探索。这些奖励无法说明候选物品的哪些方面与用户偏好存在冲突，以及下一个候选物品应如何改进。为填补这一空白，我们提出了VerRec，一个由语言化反馈引导的生成式推荐强化学习框架。具体而言，用户模拟器基于用户的历史偏好和候选物品画像生成个性化的语言化反馈。策略利用该反馈来生成经过改进的推荐结果。原始候选与改进后的候选共同构成一个扩展组，并通过组相对机制进行联合优化。
tldr: 提出VerRec框架，通过用户模拟器生成个性化的语言化反馈来引导强化学习优化生成式推荐，克服了传统标量奖励无法指明候选物品与用户偏好冲突之处及改进方向的局限。
en_tdlr: VerRec is a verbalized feedback-guided reinforcement learning framework for generative recommendation that leverages a user simulator to generate personalized verbal feedback, overcoming the limitation of scalar rewards which cannot indicate which aspects of candidates conflict with user preferences or how the next candidate should improve.
